ok-40109-bos-matter-45408.title: Discussion and possible action regarding a grant agreement by and between the City of Oklahoma City and the County of Oklahoma County related to the United States Department of Justice - Office of Justice Programs - Bureau of Justice Assistance - Justice Assistance Grants (JAG) Program FY 2025 award number O-BJA-2025-172545. This agreement states the City of Oklahoma City will waive their 10% of the funds for administrating the grant. Oklahoma City will receive $278,025.00, Del City will receive $7,968.00, Midwest City will receive $13,733.00, Edmond will receive $9,782.00 and the County of Oklahoma County $173,157.00. The Sheriff’s Office will utilize the funds in the same manner as the previous JAG funds to support Land Mobile Radio and Equipment/Services contracted through the City of Oklahoma City. The funds are required to be spent by September 30th, 2027. There are no matching funds required. This item is requested by Sheriff Tommie Johnson III.

ok-40109-bos-matter-45442.title: Discussion and possible action to approve or deny Resolution No. 2026-4362 accepting the final plat of Windstone Estates Addition, pursuant to Title 19, §868.8 of the Oklahoma Statutes. This final plat (FP-2026-10) was denied by the Planning Commission on October 15th, 2026. The plat consists of fifty-six (56) lots encompassing approximately fifty-nine (59.55) acres. The subject property is located on N MacArthur Blvd just south of NW 220th St., in County Commissioner District 3. Requested by Erik Brandt, Principal Planner, and approved as to form and legality by Lisa Endres, Assistant District Attorney.
